eligible_rule: P0 and UNTESTED rows on latest worker-ready baseline; exclude IDs with live origin/research/ma-* branches or MA directories in that baseline
sampling: Rejection sample SHA256(seed_bytes || counter_u32_be), reject values >= floor(2^256/n)*n, index=value mod n

selected_row.mirror_coordinate: layer input-statistics map to View coefficients
selected_row.logical_multiplicity: merged logical model without source data
selected_row.mirror_delta: Use RegMean-style Gram statistics to solve for compact View coefficients instead of full layer weights.
selected_row.worker_note: Report metadata cost of statistics and compare full RegMean.
